title: Sr Electrical Engineer
description:
Senior Electrical Engineer
Direct Hire
Salary is 120 to 140k with a full benefits package
Cleveland OH or Pittsburgh PA
 
Why Work for Our Client
  • Growth Opportunity and Great Reputation in the Industry
  • A hybrid work model for work-life flexibility (based on business and client needs)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Paid Time Off, Company Paid Holidays
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Paid Certifications and Registrations (as applicable)
 
Summary of Job Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  • Manage necessary resources for execution.
  • Collect and prepare data/information, performs detailed calculations, and write formal technical reports.
  • Develop technical specifications & data sheets, perform technical evaluation of bids, and recommend best value design which meets client requirements for operability, reliability, maintainability and safety.
  • Serve as a discipline interface to client on discipline issues and attend significant client meetings involving discipline issues.
  • Review calculations and vendor drawings.
  • Develop, update, and monitor project discipline schedules, budgets, and staffing forecasts including Work Process tools (e.g., Project Schedule and Earned Value).
 
Required Qualifications and Education
  • 5+ years of electrical systems design experience in a consulting organization.
  • BS degree in Electrical Engineering or Technology.
  • Working knowledge of single line diagrams, schematics, PID's, and application of NEC.
  • Experience with Front End Engineering and Design or Front-End Loading studies.
  • Experience with power distribution
 
If you are ready for your new Position and Qualified we want to talk to you.

Kristie at kharnish@blackrockres.com

title: Maintenance Mechanic
description:
Maintenance Mechanic
Las Vegas, NV
Direct Hire
$30-33/hour

We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Mechanic to join a fast-paced manufacturing team. This role requires strong electrical experience to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain production equipment, ensuring minimal downtime.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose and repair electrical systems, PLCs, and control circuits.
  • Perform preventive maintenance on machinery, including conveyors, motors, and automated systems.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues under tight deadlines.
  • Collaborate with production teams to maintain operational efficiency.
  • Document repairs and adhere to safety standards.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong electrical skills, including wiring, circuit troubleshooting, and PLC knowledge.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints.
  • Comfortable working 2nd or 3rd shift, including weekends as needed.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.
  • Technical certification or equivalent experience preferred.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist IV (Solar Projects)
description:
You must be able to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. No C2C or 3rd parties, please.

Are you an experienced Quality Assurance professional with a passion for ensuring excellence in large-scale Solar Projects? This opportunity offers the chance to play a key role in driving quality, compliance, and performance from the ground up — literally, from initial site work through commissioning.

We’re looking for someone who:
  • Has deep knowledge of quality assurance and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Can conduct audits, review and analyze data, and evaluate documentation to ensure alignment with requirements.
  • Brings at least 10+ years of direct experience in the field — an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Is familiar with a wide range of concepts, practices, and procedures related to QA in the energy or solar sector.
  • Relies on extensive experience and sound judgment to plan, execute, and accomplish goals.
  • Has a complete understanding of Solar Projects, from design and construction through commissioning.
  • Is comfortable leading and directing others, with creativity and latitude to shape outcomes.
If you thrive in a leadership role where precision and quality make a measurable impact, this position offers the autonomy and challenge you’ve been looking for.

Candidates that meet the criteria above may send their resume directly to Brandon at bgreen@blackrockres.com
